position: Source intake is rights-first and publication-blocked
headline: A candidate cannot become a reviewed source record by filling out a form.
copy: The intake packet records evidence and routing, then stops at draft status until real rights and reviewer operations exist.

postures.title: Citation
postures.copy: Every candidate names a precise source location.

postures.title: Rights lane
postures.copy: Citation-only, public-domain, permission-recorded, needs-review, and blocked remain distinct.

postures.title: Evidence
postures.copy: Any usable rights lane needs a human-readable evidence note.

postures.title: Reviewer route
postures.copy: A named review lane must receive the candidate.

postures.title: Publication
postures.copy: The validator always emits publication_state blocked.

flow.title: Identify
flow.copy: Record citation, source family, and edition note.

flow.title: Bound
flow.copy: Write the summary and answer boundary without copied translation text.

flow.title: Evidence
flow.copy: Choose a rights lane and record its evidence.

flow.title: Route
flow.copy: Create a draft packet for human review, never publication.

decisions.label: Full text
decisions.reason: This intake stores metadata and summaries, not translation text.

decisions.label: Approval
decisions.reason: A form submission cannot approve itself.

decisions.label: Storage
decisions.reason: The browser creates a copyable draft but does not save it.

decisions.label: Registry merge
decisions.reason: No candidate enters the reviewed registry automatically.

locks.title: Live AI lock
locks.copy: No model call or generated scripture is enabled.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: No durable learner, reviewer, observation, or telemetry storage is created.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: No translation text is published without recorded rights evidence.

locks.title: Authority lock
locks.copy: The product remains study and reflection support, not a guru, clinician, or ritual authority.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: Private-demo evidence does not authorize a public service.

packet:
Rights-Cleared Source Intake v4.8.4
Output: vedapath.source-intake.v1 draft packet.
Invariant: publication_state is always blocked.
Boundary: metadata and reviewed summary only; no translation text.

sample.edition_note: Citation metadata only; translation selection pending.
sample.summary: Candidate for a careful discussion of stewardship and restraint.
sample.boundary: Do not flatten the verse into financial or productivity advice.
sample.rights_evidence: Only citation metadata and an original short summary are included.
